name: Jade van der Hoorn
bio: Kia Ora and congratulations on your hapūtanga (pregnancy) journey! I am a mama of 3 residing in Upper Hutt providing culturally safe care for whānau across the Hutt Valley region. I have a strong belief in the body's innate ability to give birth and that knowledge is power. My job is to help support, educate and guide you to bring your pēpi earthside in the place you feel safest to do so whether that be home or hospital.

name: Shari Bewley
bio: Kia ora and let me congratulate you on your pregnancy. Giving birth is a beautiful, life changing experience. During my career I have worked as a Core Midwife, Lead Maternity Carer and most recently, a Theatre Midwife at the Lower Hutt Hospital. My experience in both settings has given me a depth of knowledge and experience that allows me to support you through your journey. As part of the Manaaki Midwives team, I offer antenatal, labour and birth care across the Hutt Valley and am happy to support women who are having an elective c-section as their choice of birth. Throughout your pregnancy and childbirth experience, I will ensure that you are fully informed and aware of your options during this special time.

name: Gemma McAlister
bio: Kia Ora, I am an LMC based in the Hutt Valley, and a mother of four. As a midwife, my philosophy is based on the belief that childbirth is a natural life event deserving of respect and empowerment. I strive to provide midwifery care that is informed, safe, and tailored to each individual, creating a supportive environment where you can make choices that align with your unique needs.

name: Petra McDiarmid
bio: My name is Petra McDiarmid, and I am in my final year of midwifery. I live in Lower Hutt with my partner, our three children, and far too many pets. Midwifery has been a passion of mine for many years, and I am incredibly excited to begin my career with the wonderful team at Manaaki Midwives. My goal is to provide parents with the knowledge and support they need to make informed decisions that are right for them, whether they are welcoming their first baby or their sixth. I am passionate about helping families feel prepared for the journey ahead and supporting them to navigate pregnancy, birth, and early parenthood with confidence. I believe birth is a powerful and transformative experience. Being trusted to walk alongside families through pregnancy, birth, and the transition to parenthood is both a privilege and an honour, and I look forward to supporting and empowering whānau during this special time.
